stages.title: Foundations
stages.goal: Write a function, debug a failure, trace a request and query, and explain a small UI change.
stages.gate: Seven foundations exit tasks, with learner code and a changed case.

stages.title: Guided changes
stages.goal: Make small tested changes and respond to review feedback.
stages.gate: Two small reviewed changes, own tests, failure traces and explanations.

stages.title: Independent feature ownership
stages.goal: Clarify, implement, test and support a bounded feature yourself.
stages.gate: Two different feature cycles; rubric 2 across relevant dimensions and one transfer task at 3.

stages.title: Reliability and operations
stages.goal: Explain failure boundaries, measure changes and recover safely.
stages.gate: Small crash demonstration, complete accounting, measured change and recovery note.

stages.title: Senior judgment practice
stages.goal: Handle ambiguity, justify tradeoffs and improve work through real collaboration.
stages.gate: Repeated shared-project decisions, feedback, human review and observed handover; no automatic job title.

assessment_policy: Curriculum checks and platform evidence never mark learner gates complete.
